plan.major: Television, Film, and Digital Media (Emerging Media Concentration)
plan.notes: Source: Ithaca College official 'Eight Semester Sample Plans' (Roy H. Park School of Communications), Television Film and Digital Media B.S. — Emerging Media Concentration, 2026-2027, transcribed exactly as published (sample/suggested plan — flexibility explicitly noted by the college). Credit ranges resolved at MINIMUM per pipeline policy with disclosure: Semester 2 'choose one' slot 2-4 cr recorded at 2; Semester 4 has two 3-4 cr slots recorded at 3, yielding 14 credits while the official plan publishes 'Total Credits 15-16' for Semester 4 — students should plan 15+ credits in Semester 4 per the official plan; Semester 5 ICC slot and Semester 8 open-elective slot recorded at 3. Plan sums to 122 credits at minimum resolution; Ithaca College requires 120 credits minimum for the BS ('must earn 30 credits per year'). GCOM 12500 Safety Training is a 0-credit requirement. Course-option footnotes (Theory/Research/Studies/Foundational/Technical/Capstone/ICC double-counts) are preserved verbatim in choice_note fields. No prerequisites are published in the plan; semester order is as published.
